name: JAL 602 雷暴绕飞 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is JAL 602, a flight from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters, make initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 JAL 602，从东京飞往武汉，现在飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: you now have an indication of a thunderstorm on your radar screen, 50km ahead of you, request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你的雷达屏幕显示前方 50 公里处有雷暴，请求空中交通管制许可向右偏置 5 英里。
cards.referenceText: Control, JAL 602, thunderstorm 50 kilometers ahead, request offset five miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，JAL 602，前方 50 公里处有雷暴，请求向右偏置 5 英里。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, offset 5 miles to the right approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 5 海里，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Later you find more thunderstorms ahead of you, request climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：随后你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request climb to 10700 meters due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，因天气请求爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 60210700 meters not available due to military activity at the moment, can you accept 11300 meters?
B: tell the controller you are unable to climb to 11300 meters due performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，因军事活动，目前 10700 米不可用，能否接受 11300 米？
B： 告诉管制员，因性能原因你无法爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: negative, unable 2300 meters, due performance, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，因性能原因无法爬升至 2300 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: To avoid thunderstorm, you request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for fifty miles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：为避让雷暴，你请求右转航向 240，并保持该航向 50 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，为避让雷暴，请求右转航向 240 并保持该航向 50 海里。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, negative, heading 240 is not available due restricted area. Deviation to the left is available, say your intention.
B: tell the controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，不行，因限制区，航向 240 不可用。可以向左偏航，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你希望左转航向 080。
cards.referenceText: roger, request turn left heading 080, JAL 602.

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告，JAL 602。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, how many miles do you want to fly on this heading?
B: Tell the controller fifty miles is enough for you.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，你想沿该航向飞多少海里？
B：告诉管制员 50 海里足够。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of weather, inform Wuhan Control and request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，通知武汉管制，并请求直飞 ZF 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see CBs in front of you, you want to maneuver 2 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在看到前方有 CB，想向右机动 2 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request maneuver 2 miles to the right due to CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，前方有 CB，请求向右机动 2 海里。

cards.audioText: B: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and ask for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机动过程中，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，向武汉进近报告情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL 602, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL 602，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, roger, you are No. 1, expect radar vectors, do you require any medical assistance on arrival?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance and you will open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，收到，你是第 1 个，预计雷达引导。到达时是否需要医疗援助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要医疗援助，并将打开后舱门，用担架将患病旅客送下飞机。
cards.referenceText: request medical assistance, open the rear cabin door, deplane the sick passenger stretcher, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求医疗援助，打开后舱门，用担架将患病旅客送下飞机，JAL 602。
